metadata.description: Governed Claude skills for Meridian Wealth Partners. Every plugin here was published through the LightCI Activate promotion queue: each skill has an owner, a Grader pass, a compliance boundary declaration and a named approver.

plugins.name: fp-meeting-prep
plugins.description: Financial Planning: meeting briefs, RMD letters and annual review deck outlines built from templates and CRM summaries.

plugins.name: wa-client-comms
plugins.description: Wealth Advisors: same-day follow-up emails with CRM notes, proposal assembly, fee-change communications and IPS refresh checklists.

plugins.name: cso-operations
plugins.description: Client Service Ops: onboarding packet QA, compliance attestation summaries and rebalancing exception memos. Highest boundary sensitivity; compliance co-owns.

plugins.name: shared
plugins.description: Cross-team skills assigned to every in-program group. Also carries the Activate connector (.mcp.json) and the Activate Coach skill.

plugins.name: activate-coach
plugins.description: LightCI Activate Coach: ladder, next exercise, grading, workflow mapping, team and promotion views inside Claude. Bundles the Activate MCP connector.
